title: k-Dimensional Hockey Stick Identity by Induction on Dimension

problemStatement.formal: simplicialSum as n = simplicial (as.sum + as.length) n
problemStatement.plain: The iterated convolution of simplicial numbers over a k-simplex equals a single simplicial number.
whyMatters: Generalizes the 1D and 2D hockey stick identities to arbitrary dimension

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: ArithmeticSeriesOQ02OQ02OQ01.lean - k-dim hockey stick, 130 lines, 0 axioms, 0 sorries. Proved by induction on parameter list using parallel Vandermonde.
builtItems: simplicialSum: iterated convolution of simplicial numbers
insights: Induction on the parameter list (not on k or n) gives the cleanest proof
Each step uses parallel_vandermonde to fold one dimension
generalizing n in the induction is essential since the inner sum varies n-i
simp_rw rewrites under Finset.sum binders where conv/rw cannot
